title: APM metric shows a description on the widget-creation Metric dropdown
preconditions: APM data source exists so the APM category lists at least one metric

steps.action: Navigate to Dashboard and start Add/Create Widget
steps.expected: Widget creation screen opens

steps.action: Set the data category / source type to 'APM'
steps.expected: Metric dropdown repopulates with APM metrics

steps.action: Open the Metric dropdown and select the first APM metric
steps.expected: Metric is selected

steps.action: Observe the description affordance (pop-up/tooltip/info panel) for the selected metric
steps.expected: A non-empty description is shown for the APM metric

edge_cases: metric with the longest text — pop-up must not truncate/overflow
postcondition: No widget needs to be saved; description verified in-flow

title: Description content conveys meaning (what it measures / how to read / root-cause hint)

steps.action: For one metric per category (APM/RUM/Log/NetRoute/Flow), open its description
steps.expected: Description present

steps.action: Read the description text
steps.expected: Text is meaningful (not a placeholder/key), describes what the metric measures and/or how values are interpreted

expected: description_text: meaningful (length > N, not equal to the metric key/id)
edge_cases: a description equal to the metric's raw key id == fail (data not mapped)
postcondition: Content quality recorded; exact wording is product copy, not asserted verbatim
automation: Partial (assert non-empty + not-equal-to-key; verbatim copy is manual)

title: Description format/structure is consistent across all categories
preconditions: description data seeded for every category

steps.action: Trigger the description affordance for one metric in each of Metric/APM/RUM/Log/NetRoute/Flow
steps.expected: Same control/role/container surfaces the description in every category

steps.action: Compare the rendered structure
steps.expected: Consistent format (same component, same placement, same trigger gesture)

automation: Yes (structural — same locator pattern resolves in every category)

title: Metric with no description data shows an 'unavailable' message, not a blank
preconditions: a metric known to LACK mapped description data is identified live

data.metric: <a metric with no description — resolve live; may not exist on this build>

steps.action: Select a metric whose description data is missing
steps.expected: Metric selected

steps.action: Observe the description affordance
steps.expected: UI shows an explicit 'description unavailable for this metric' message (not empty, not error toast)

edge_cases: if every metric on the build has data, this case is N/A on this server — record, do not fake
automation: Conditional (only if a description-less metric exists on the target build)

title: Disambiguate the description trigger (select vs hover) and confirm it is discoverable

steps.action: Open the Metric dropdown for an APM metric; hover over the metric option
steps.expected: Record whether hover surfaces the description (ticket TC steps say hover)

steps.action: Select the metric
steps.expected: Record whether selection surfaces the description (AC A4 says on-select)

expected: description reachable by at least one documented gesture; the working gesture is recorded for automation
edge_cases: ticket is contradictory (hover vs select) — the live behavior is authoritative
postcondition: Canonical trigger gesture decided for the spec
automation: Yes (drives the locator strategy for all other cases)
